_about: Labelled chat messages for the chat router (CR-1, control-plane src/chat-capability-route.js; web src/inline-ai-route.js CHAT_CAPABILITIES). Owner 2026-11-13: for each routable slash command, messages a learner would really type that do NOT contain the command's own word, plus messages that must stay a normal chat answer, so the JEV classifier can be measured and tuned. test/chat-route-prompts.test.js pins the shape; scripts/chat-route-eval.mjs runs them against the real classifier (paid, run only on the owner's go). A capability's key is its registry id (generate-image types as /image, image as /photos, explain as /interactive).
